latest_release.name: v0.13.2
latest_release.body:
### Fixed

- 🔓 **Chat over plain HTTP.** Opening Open WebUI over plain HTTP at a LAN or Docker address now loads new and existing chats instead of staying on a spinner with "crypto.randomUUID is not a function". [#33919](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/33919)
- 📝 **Comments and Markdown editing over plain HTTP.** Creating, replying to and editing comments, and editing Markdown files containing rendered blocks such as Mermaid diagrams or callouts, no longer fail with the same UUID error. [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/3c400952cbb30e8eb72652d83b2af2f75a3b9341)
- 🎛️ **Side Chat permission switch.** The Allow Side Chat switch is now visible even when Temporary Chat is off, so administrators can configure the two permissions independently. [#33920](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33920)

hot_issues.title: feat: Add model-level toggle to disable reinjecting reasoning/thinking into prompts (prevents <think> tag imitation and rendering/parsing failures)
feat: Different content extraction settings for chat and knowledge-base
feat: send audio and video directly to natively multimodal models instead of forcing STT transcription

discussions.title: bug: Open Terminal selector disabled in legacy chats created with v0.13.0 or earlier (v0.13.2)
feat: Run OCR on chat images via the configured extraction engine and pass the text to the model alongside the image
Any quick toggle / fast switch to change PDFs handling engine?
[Feature Request] Bind TTS Auto-Playback to Model Parameters / Metadata for Multi-Device Contexts
The tab bar in a chat paints a solid strip over the Chat Background Image
feat: the Files pane's Ask or edit box fills the chat input when Insert Follow-Up Prompt to Input is on
Long chats with local models that pick up after a restart (llama.cpp add-on)
Knowledge Bases connected to Channels & Allow models to create knowledge base entries

Open WebUI

Open WebUI is a home for AI: an extensible, easy-to-use, self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline. Connect local models through Ollama or use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models.

detail.readme:
Open WebUI

Open WebUI is a home for AI: an extensible, easy-to-use, self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline. Connect local models through Ollama or use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md) | [繁體中文](README.zht.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md) | [Deutsch](README.de.md) | [Español](README.es.md) | [Français](README.fr.md) | [Italiano](README.it.md) | [Dansk](README.da.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [Polski](README.pl.md) | [Русский](README.ru.md) | [Bosanski](README.bs.md) | [العربية](README.ar.md) | [Norsk](README.no.md) | [Português (Brasil)](README.br.md) | [ไทย](README.th.md) | [Türkçe](README.tr.md) | [Українська](README.uk.md) | [বাংলা](README.bn.md) | [Ελληνικά](README.gr.md) | [Tiếng Việt](README.vi.md) [![Open WebUI Demo](https://cdn.openwebui.com/open-webui-demo.gif)](https://docs.openwebui.com/) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub watchers](https://img.shields.io/github/watchers/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub repo size](https://img.shields.io/github/repo-size/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub language count](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/count/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub top language](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/top/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/open-webui/open-webui?color=red) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Open_WebUI-blue?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/5rJgQTnV4s) [![](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Sponsor&message=Support&logo=GitHub&color=%23fe8e86)](https://github.com/sponsors/open-webui) [Explore Open WebUI →](https://docs.openwebui.com/) ### Installation #### Python ```bash # With uv installed (macOS/Linux) DATA_DIR=~/.open-webui uvx --python 3.12 open-webui@latest serve # Or install and run with pip (Python 3.12) pip install open-webui open-webui serve ``` Then open [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080). #### Docker ```bash docker run -d -p 3000:8080 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main ``` Then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). | Image tag | Includes | | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `:main` | Standard image with local AI dependencies | | `:slim` | Lightweight image using external services for embeddings, document extraction, and voice | | `:cuda` | Open WebUI with CUDA acceleration | | `:ollama` | Open WebUI bundled with Ollama | | `:dev` | Latest development build | Add these options to `docker run` before the image name as needed: | Option | Purpose | | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `-e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://your-ollama-server:11434` | Connect to Ollama on another server | | `-e OPENAI_API_KEY=your_secret_key` | Set your OpenAI API key | | `-e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` | Disable Hugging Face model downloads for offline use | | `--gpus all` | Enable Nvidia GPU access for `:cuda` or `:ollama`; requires the Nvidia Container Toolkit | See the [Docker installation guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/quick-start/) for setup instructions and configuration options. #### Desktop App [Download the native desktop app](https://github.com/open-webui/desktop) for macOS, Windows, and Linux. [Read the docs →](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/) ### Ecosystem - [Open Terminal](https://github.com/open-webui/open-terminal) / [Terminals (Enterprise)](https://github.com/open-webui/terminals): The action layer that turns Open WebUI into a full agent harness, with enterprise orchestration for per-user workspaces. - [Knowledge Base Sync (oikb)](https://github.com/open-webui/oikb): Mirror folders, repos, buckets, and wikis into Open WebUI Knowledge Bases with incremental sync. - [Open WebUI Computer](https://github.com/open-webui/computer): Your computer in any browser: files, editor, terminal, git, and optional AI agents, running on your real machine. See the [ecosystem documentation](https://docs.openwebui.com/ecosystem/) for details. ### Troubleshooting and Updates See the [troubleshooting guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/troubleshooting/) for connection issues and the [updating guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/updating) to update your installation. ### Documentation See the [docs](https://docs.openwebui.com/) for configuration and usage, and the [roadmap](https://docs.openwebui.com/roadmap/) for planned work. For Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and other setups, see the [installation docs](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/). ### Support [Open an issue](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues) or [start a discussion](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/discussions). Find us on [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/OpenWebUI/), [X](https://x.com/OpenWebUI), and [Discord](https://discord.gg/5rJgQTnV4s). ### Security Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/security). Security reports are accepted only through GitHub. ### Star History #### License Includes code under the Open WebUI License, which requires preserving the Open WebUI branding, and prior contributions under their original licenses. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE) and [LICENSE_HISTORY](./LICENSE_HISTORY) for terms and history.
